description_zh: 调用DeleteNatIp接口删除NAT IP地址
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-nat-ip --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-ip-id vpcnatip-gw8y7q3cpk3fggs870000 --nat-gateway-id ngw-gw8v16wgvtq26vh590000 --ipv4-prefix 192.168.0.0/28 --dry-run false --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF3898 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteNatIp

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NAT gateway instance to which the NAT IP address belongs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的NAT IP地址所属NAT网关实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT IP address to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的NAT IP地址实例ID
parameters.name: nat_ip_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the NAT gateway to which the IP prefix belongs. This parameter is required when you delete an IP prefix
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的IP前缀所属的NAT网关实例ID。  当删除IP前缀时需要指定
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The IP prefix address to delete
parameters.name: ipv4_prefix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run without deleting the NAT IP address. The system checks the AccessKey pair, the authorization of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user, and the required parameters. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.

false (default): sends a Normal request. After the check succeeds, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the NAT IP address is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除NAT IP地址。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，会返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回2xx HTTP状态码并删除NAT IP地址
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
